checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Same matte black bottle recognizable, shape and details preserved
must.why: Shape, cap loop and ridges match; base band slightly more defined.

must.item: Bottle on light stone counter, not wooden table

must.why: White cabinets, backsplash, stove, plant, window.

must.item: Clean edges and believable contact shadow, not floating
must.why: Grounded with a cast shadow to the right and soft base contact.

faults.what: Bottle base gained a slightly more defined band/lower seam than the original, so it is not pixel-identical.
Background is soft and blurry, with slightly generic AI-looking clutter.

summary: The bottle was placed convincingly on a light stone counter in a bright modern kitchen, with only tiny base-detail drift and low resolution as drawbacks.
